information.description:
Militech's four-armed espionage body, the heir to the Spyder. Scalar Hands let it hang off a tower wall and work a window with the other two arms. More psychosis-prone than a war borg, as Militech's own therapists will tell you off the record.

Cost: 25,900eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 76 ([1d6/2] + 23d6)
Frame: Beta (14): BODY 14
Eyes: MonoVision
Base chrome (no HL): Cyberarm ×2
Chrome: Amplified Hearing, Artificial Shoulder Mount, Chipware Socket, Enhanced Holophone, FBC Chameleon Coating, Grapple Hand ×4, Grip Foot ×2, Image Enhance, Internal Hydraulics Upgrade (Tuned), Low Light/Infrared/UV, MicroVideo, Scalar Hands, Tactile Boost, TeleOptics

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
